source:
@@U03855@@
Lead these young lovelies In a formal round.

@@U03857@@
I wish it were over. These antics disturb me. (The CHORUS sings as it performs intricate dance patterns with

@@U03859@@
)

@@U03861@@
When you raise your arms so fair, Lifting them so charmingly, When you shake your shining hair, And shift your curls alarmingly, When you with your foot so light Brush the earth in hasty flight, And your limbs with ours entwine, First with hers and then with mine, Then, sweet boy, you've reached your goal, For you have won our very soul.

@@U03862@@
(Pause.)

@@U03864@@
Fleet-footed deer, How many are here! Come out and play With me today! I'll be the hunter And you'll be my prey.

@@U03866@@
Don’t run too fast, We're yours already. First and last We're willing and ready. You sweet, you handsome, You loveliest of boys!
translation:
@@U03855@@
带领这些年轻的可爱们参加正式的比赛。

@@U03857@@
我希望一切都结束了。这些滑稽的动作让我不安。 （合唱团边唱边表演复杂的舞蹈模式

@@U03859@@
）

@@U03861@@
当你如此美丽地举起你的手臂，如此迷人地举起它们，当你摇动你闪亮的头发，并令人惊恐地移动你的卷发，当你用你的脚如此轻盈，在匆忙的飞行中刷过大地，而你的四肢与我们的四肢缠绕在一起，首先与她的，然后与我的，然后，可爱的孩子，你已经达到了你的目标，因为你赢得了我们的灵魂。

@@U03862@@
（停顿。）

@@U03864@@
快步鹿，这里有多少只！今天就出来陪我玩吧！我将成为猎人，而你将成为我的猎物。

@@U03866@@
别跑太快，我们已经是你的了。首先也是最后我们愿意并准备好。你可爱，你英俊，你最可爱的男孩！
